title: Unit evaluation of the canonical exceptional tensor mate in comparison coordinates
statement: Use the finite coefficient setting P of [def-pur-conventions], and let f:X → Y be any compactifiable scheme morphism. Write Q for the degree-zero ordinary etale coefficient unit, C for exact pullback from the ordinary etale to the pro-etale site, and omega_f for the pro-etale dualizing object [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. The canonical tensor mate theta_f of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], evaluated at K=C(Q), represented by Q with the identity representation, equals (e_f tensor identity);lambda_{omega_f}. Here e_f:Lf*(C(Q)) ≅ 1 is the following fixed composite: exact pullback of the coefficient-unit map projectionUnitRaw [def-pur-affine-diagonal-tate-coordinates], inverse of the exact/left-derived pullback comparison, and the derived pullback-unit isomorphism. No smoothness, relative dimension, orientation, Tate twist, or affine comparison is used in this identity.

proof.text: On the ordinary etale site, expand the canonical tensor transpose as the adjunct of inverse projection followed by the exceptional counit. At the tensor unit, the proved source-library identity Etale.projectionMap_rightUnitality identifies projection followed by the mapped pullback-unit right unitor with the right unitor. Apply adjunct uniqueness and the adjunction triangle: the transpose at the unit is tensor with the pullback-unit map followed by the right unitor. Naturality in the coefficient input transports this identity along the degree-zero-unit isomorphism smoothPurityUnitIso. The symmetry in smoothPurityEtaleTheta changes the right-unitor formula to the left-unitor formula.

source.place: Specialization of the displayed tensor/counit composite to the coefficient unit

proof.text: Expand smoothPurityTensorComparison and smoothPurityTheta. Naturality moves diagonalDualizingComparison through tensor and the left unitor; its inverse comparison-unit factor cancels the final comparison-adjunction-unit factor of theta. The exact site comparison preserves tensor evaluation into the coefficient unit. Its pullback compatibility identifies the remaining unit map with exact pullback of projectionUnitRaw followed by inverse exact/left-derived comparison and the pullback-unit isomorphism. Thus the surviving composite is the stated left unitor after tensoring e_f. All cancellations are of specified isomorphisms, so identity morphisms, empty schemes and zero coefficient rings satisfy the same calculation.

theorem smoothPurityTheta_unit (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] :
    let e :=
      (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
          (X := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient Y))
          (projectionUnitRaw P.Coefficient Y) ≪≫
        (ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f).symm.app _ ≪≫
        ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f
    P.smoothPurityTheta f
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient Y))
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient Y) (Iso.refl _) =
      (((curriedTensor (_root_.DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))).mapIso
            e).app (P.diagonalDualizing f) ≪≫
        λ_ (P.diagonalDualizing f)).hom
